title: NeuroFlow Provenance Document
description: Normalized NeuroFlow provenance document: a record of one workflow run, aligned with W3C PROV concepts (Entity, Activity, Agent) and intended to be embeddable in BIDS-Derivatives datasets and RO-Crate research objects.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support.

agents.description: Software, person, and organization participants. PROV: Agent.

activities.description: Ordered record of step executions. PROV: Activity.

entities.description: Inputs, intermediate outputs, and final outputs referenced by activities. PROV: Entity.

inputs.description: Workflow input identifiers resolved to entity ids.

outputs.description: Workflow output identifiers resolved to entity ids. These are the final products of the run.

context.description: Final snapshot of run-context values, by context field identifier.

decisions.description: Branch points, fix proposals, and operator decisions taken during the run.

events.description: Compact summary of notable runtime events. Full event log is implementation-defined.

runId.description: Runtime-assigned identifier. Matches the runId carried in the runtime-events envelope.

status.description: Terminal status. `partial` indicates the run completed with one or more tolerated step failures (per the workflow's errorPolicy). `halted` indicates the runtime stopped the run at a step failure before its public outputs were produced. `in-progress` is allowed for snapshots taken while a run is still executing.

haltedAtStep.description: When status is `halted` or `failed`, the step id at which the run stopped.

cancelReason.description: When status is `cancelled`, optional human-readable reason.

workflowRef.description: Identifies the workflow document the run executed.

checksum.description: Optional digest of the workflow JSON as executed.

agentDef.description: A software, person, or organization participant.

id.description: Agent identifier, unique within this document.

binary.description: Resolved binary path or container image reference, when applicable.

contact.description: Email or ORCID, for person/organization agents.

role.description: Free-text role, e.g. operator, conversion-tool, validator.

id.description: Activity identifier, unique within this document.

agent.description: Agent id that performed the activity.

status.description: Activity status. `partial` indicates the step finished and produced outputs but accumulated one or more tolerated item failures.

used.description: Entity ids consumed as inputs. PROV: used.

generated.description: Entity ids produced as outputs. PROV: wasGeneratedBy.

contextWrites.description: Context fields written by this activity, mapped to their final values for this activity.

itemFailures.description: Per-item failures observed during this activity, drawn from core:item-error events emitted by the tool. The presence of entries here is what distinguishes a `partial` activity from a clean `completed` one.

attempts.description: Number of times the step was executed in this run. Greater than 1 indicates the runtime retried the step after a failure (a runtime-level concern; this field merely records what happened).

handlerFor.description: When this activity is an error-handler run (declared by workflow.errorPolicy.onError), the step id of the failing step it was triggered for.

itemFailureDef.description: Record of one core:item-error event surfaced into the provenance.

input.description: Tool input on which the item appeared.

entityDef.description: An input, intermediate, or output artifact.

id.description: Entity identifier, unique within this document.

role.description: How the entity participates in the run.

path.description: Filesystem path for file/directory entities, relative to the run output root when possible.

value.description: Embedded value for non-file entities (small JSON values).

size.description: Size in bytes for file entities.

derivedFrom.description: Entity ids this entity was derived from. PROV: wasDerivedFrom.

bidsEntities.description: Optional BIDS entity key/values for entities that live inside a BIDS dataset.

decisionDef.description: A branch point, fix proposal, or operator decision taken during the run.

activity.description: Activity id this decision belongs to, when applicable.

agent.description: Agent id that made or recorded the decision.

proposal.description: Reference to the fix proposal involved, when kind is fix-proposal / fix-approval / fix-rejection.

entity.description: Entity id holding the fix proposal value.

eventSummaryDef.description: Compact event log entry. Full envelopes live in implementation-specific event stores.

bidsEntities.description: BIDS entity key/value pairs from BIDS Common Principles. Validators MAY check that supplied keys are drawn from a known BIDS entity set.
